contributor_notes: Set in 1993 at 'God's Promise' conversion therapy center. Cameron's lesbian identity is explicit in the source; Coley, Jane, and Adam are less specifically labeled — flagged accordingly. Director Desiree Akhavan co-wrote and adapted the novel, but the source gives no information about her identity, so she is not listed as a queer creator. Source notes emotional abuse and religious trauma, which have no exact enum match; child-abuse used to cover the abuse of teen residents. Ending appears hopeful (the friends escape) but 'happy-ending' left off pending maintainer review. Please verify subtitle/audio and creator details from other sources.
